placements.title: A diagnostic is sized to the people actually there to interview, and starts where the work happens
placements.frame: What does this expression say about how the diagnostic's length is fitted to the system and people it studies, and about which group it hears from first?
placements.why: The position holds a duration cut from two weeks to eight working days because there are only four shift leads to interview. It also holds the sequencing of warehouse team before management as unchanged. Both point to one recurring theme: diagnostic scope follows the real system, and the front line is heard first. Future engagements will keep feeding this theme, so it is more than a one-off schedule fact. No existing leaf is close, since the only one concerns participant data retention.

unconnected.why: The only existing stratum covers participant recording retention, which this leaf does not touch. This document alone does not yet show a cross-graph grouping worth minting.
